origin.description: Reads a Stata file. This is read_dta.
origin.usage: read_stata(file, encoding = NULL, col_select = NULL, skip = 0, n_max = Inf, .name_repair = "unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

origin.details: The arguments and the result are the same as read_dta.

translation.description: Reads a Stata file. This is read_dta.
translation.usage: read_stata(file, encoding=None, col_select=None, skip=0, n_max=float("inf"), name_repair="unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

translation.details: The arguments and the result are the same as read_dta.
translation.example:
from haven import read_stata
d = read_stata("/home/ahmed/R/library/haven/examples/iris.dta")
print(d.nrow, d.columns[0].label)
